mapper.select: select r.PBC_PROD_ID prodid ,r.REGIST_SEQNO registseqno, nvl(r.HIGH_YIELD_ISSUE,0) prodprofit1,nvl(r.LOW_YIELD_ISSUE,0) prodprofit2 from pbc_prd_baseinfo_sub r where (r.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS !='03' or r.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS is null) and to_char(r.STATUS_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')<=to_char(#{querydate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd')

select r.PBC_PROD_ID prodid ,r.REGIST_SEQNO registseqno,r.CCY, nvl(r.PROFIT,0) prodprofit1,nvl(r.CUSTOM_PROFIT,0) custprofit1 from PBC_PRD_BASEINFO_END_SUB r where (r.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS !='03' or r.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS is null) and to_char(r.STATUS_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')<=to_char(#{querydate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd')

select r.PBC_PROD_ID prodid ,r.REGIST_SEQNO registseqno,f.OPERATE_MODE operateMode, r.RAISING_DATE raisingDate,f.VDATE vdate, r.CUSTOMER_TYPE1 customerType,f.CUSTOMER_TYPE customerType1,nvl(r.RAISING_AMTSUM,0) prodprofit1 from PBC_PROD_RAISING_SUB r left join pbc_prd_baseinfo_sub f on f.PBC_PROD_ID=r.PBC_PROD_ID where (r.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS !='03' or r.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS is null) /** and f.OPERATE_MODE in ('4','5') AND to_char(RAISING_DATE,'yyyy-MM')!=to_char(f.VDATE,'yyyy-MM')**/ and to_char(r.STATUS_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')<=to_char(#{querydate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-MM-dd')

select cai.asset_code assetcode from CHB_ASSET_INFO cai where ASSET_TYPE='02' and PBC_ASSET_TYPE1 is null and mdate>#{enddate,jdbcType=DATE} and EXISTS (select 1 from chb_asset_position cap where cap.asset_code=cai.asset_code and cap.cdate=#{checkdate,jdbcType=DATE})
